content.short: Greenlane Holdings is a Berachain-focused digital asset treasury strategy participating in Proof of Liquidity.
content.description: Greenlane Holdings is a Nasdaq-listed company that has transitioned into a Berachain-focused digital asset treasury strategy. By acquiring BERA tokens and participating in Berachain’s Proof of Liquidity ecosystem, the company serves as a publicly traded proxy for exposure to the network. This pivot allows investors to gain access to the growth of the Berachain ecosystem through a regulated financial instrument. The company leverages its capital to provide liquidity and support the protocol, bridging the gap between traditional equity markets and cutting-edge decentralized finance.
